trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked the incident list, found it hadn't been created and tried again, so there's only one incident and the on-call engineer was paged once. INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up: find out what went wrong in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.

The release candidate for v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging, so the problem was visible before it reached production.
